ops.body: - **Phase 2 of Sights and Local life** (decision 0197): Culture and Community into Local life, museums, galleries, theaters, cinemas and community spaces out of the marks (an archive-recorded building or a "memorial"/"monument" name stays a Sight under History), "What I'm into" under the two headings, the out-of-town stars by the same rule, `PRESENCE_CODE` bumped and the goldens re-captured. Held until chronicles-data covers National Park Service sites or carries a listing flag, or Independence Hall, Congress Hall and the Betsy Ross House leave the marks.
ops.intro: The first phase shipped Nov 18 (SG1-SG13); what it left and what it found.

ops.body: - **A kind's dots move between rows** (sights-and-local-life UI review, U2, before this slice): on a row with something the dots sit beside Suggest a walk, on a "none" row at the right edge, so a column of dots does not line up (M3 lists: "Don't vary the position of elements within a list"). Keeping the button's slot empty on a "none" row would align them.

- **"How the marks work" looks the same open and closed** (UI review U4, before this slice): no chevron that turns; `accessibilityState.expanded` is set, so only sight lacks it. The card also says "marks" where a reader says "dots" (the cold find).

- **The tile's groups: space alone, or a hairline between them?** The cold find (pictures and your tasks only) could tell findables from places to go into on the tile only by guessing, and the UI review saw the 16 px gap read as a missing kind. A 1 px vertical line between the groups fits at 320 px (217 of 222); no word. Recommended: the hairline. Your call of Nov 18 (0198) was space alone.
